data.title: Kangaroo Leaps by 5s!
data.description: Watch the friendly kangaroo hop along the number line in jumps of 5, building your foundation for multiplication and counting fluency.

character.imagePrompt: A friendly cheerful cartoon kangaroo ready to jump

challenges.instruction: Tap each number the kangaroo lands on, one jump at a time, from 0 to 50.
challenges.hint: The kangaroo starts at 0 and adds 5.

challenges.instruction: Tap each number the kangaroo lands on, one jump at a time, from 5 to 50.
challenges.hint: Count on from 5 by adding 5 more.

challenges.instruction: Tap each number the kangaroo lands on, one jump at a time, from 15 to 50.
Tap each number the kangaroo lands on, one jump at a time, from 20 to 50.
Tap each number the kangaroo lands on, one jump at a time, from 30 to 50.
Tap each number the kangaroo lands on, one jump at a time, from 35 to 50.
challenges.hint: Every number ends in 0 or 5 when counting by 5s.
